The '''''Obuuri''''' was a [[Kondo-class assault shuttle|''Kondo''-class assault shuttle]] in use in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[44 ABY]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], it had been [[Pirate/Legends|pirated]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] for use in the Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|war fleet]]. In 44 ABY, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] called for reinforcements on [[Pydyr]]. The ''Obuuri'' was sent with [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], and dozens more [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in response to the call. On Pydyr, the ''Obuuri'' flew with the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'' in search of [[Abeloth]], but due to [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] illusions in the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]], the Sith [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] neglected to see a cliff and thus flew the ''Obuuri'' into it, resulting in their [[Death/Legends|deaths]] and the destruction of the [[Troop/Legends|troop]] shuttle.
